# Welcome to My Portfolio

This portfolio showcases my significant coursework and projects from the Master of City Planning program at University of Pennsylvania Weitzman School of Design. 

## Portfolio Structure
- **Weekly Notes:** My learning reflections and key concepts
- **Labs:** Completed assignments and analyses
- **Final Project:** Capstone modeling challenge

## About Me
Hello! I am Katie Knox, a first-year MCP student at University of Pennsylvania. By undergraduate degree was in computer science and francophone studies at Swarthmore College, and for the past three years I have worked for [National Digital Inclusion Alliance](https://www.digitalinclusion.org/). I am taking this course because I want to learn how to apply data analysis skills towards public interest problems. I just moved from Toronto back to Philadelphia, so go birds! (Raptors *and* Eagles)
